extracted.intended_audience: independent newsrooms, media organizations, editors and media executives seeking innovation, sustainability and accelerator support
extracted.subtask_description: Description of IPI’s Media Innovation & Sustainability portfolio and the design principles, programme components and outcomes for accelerators and support services helping newsrooms future‑proof editorial and business models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial, technical and editorial sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: IPI’s Media Innovation and Sustainability portfolio guides media organizations through innovation practice and business development to achieve financial, technical and editorial sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmes and interventions should support newsrooms in strengthening revenue streams, technological resilience, and editorial independence so the organization can survive and thrive over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resilience and protection of independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhance their resilience by protecting their independence and sustainability as independent newsrooms face authoritarian and legal repression, waning public trust, unstable revenue streams and digital disruption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should aim to reduce vulnerability to political/legal pressures, restore public trust, stabilize finances and adapt to digital market disruptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversified business models
rubrics_metrics.description: Equip newsrooms to build diversified business models.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPI’s approach focuses on helping organisations develop multiple revenue sources (business development training, strategic advice, core funding) rather than reliance on a single income stream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate strong connections with audiences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capacity-building and tools should be used to improve audience engagement strategies and deepen relationships with readers/listeners/viewers as part of sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage technology to advantage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs support technical innovation and adoption of tools/approaches that improve editorial production, distribution and business processes to increase competitiveness and reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailored 5–8 month Accelerator programmes
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of our flagship 5-8 month-long Accelerator programmes is tailored to the pressing needs of new media, media in transition and local media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programme length and curriculum are structured to be multi-month, intensive engagements, and should be customised for the maturity stage and context of participating outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-depth needs assessments inform learning journey
rubrics_metrics.description: The learning journey we provide is based on in-depth needs assessments with IPI’s in-house innovation experts, which then inform both broad capacity-building modules and skills development tailored to specific pain points and markets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize diagnostic assessments to identify specific challenges and design both general and bespoke training and coaching that addresses market- and outlet-specific pain points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixed methodology: training, personalised advisory, strategic advice, core funding and networking
rubrics_metrics.description: Our methodology includes a unique mix of training, personalized advisory services, strategic advice, core funding and networking opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective programmes combine multiple intervention types — learning modules, 1:1 advisory, small grants/core funding and facilitated networking — rather than relying on a single mode of support.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1:1 coaching and experimental space to test ideas
rubrics_metrics.description: With the support of expert speakers and innovation methodology coaches working 1:1 with the media organizations, we provide a space to experiment, develop and test ideas, as well as the funding to bring these ideas to life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide individualized coaching time, a safe environment to pilot innovations (product/format/business experiments), and resources to implement promising tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to global peer network
rubrics_metrics.description: Our beneficiaries gain access to IPI’s global network of editors, journalists and media executives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Networking and peer connections are an intentional programme outcome to enable knowledge exchange, partnerships and mentorship beyond the programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact monitoring and programme evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: IPI facilitates media innovation programmes’ impact monitoring (role noted in staff responsibilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build monitoring processes into programmes to track outcomes, measure impact on business/editorial sustainability and inform iterative improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational supports: mentorship, toolstack, communications and showcasing
rubrics_metrics.description: Support offerings include Media Innovation Mentorship programme, Transition Accelerator, team toolstack, communications and showcasing innovation, revenue and sustainability stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement capacity-building with hands-on mentorship, practical toolkits, communications support and opportunities to publicize successful innovations to attract partners/funders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting new, transitioning and local media
rubrics_metrics.description: Programmes are aimed at new media, media in transition and local media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility and design should consider the specific challenges of early-stage outlets, organizations undergoing transition, and locally focused newsrooms with constrained resources.
